criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Information Seeking
categories.definition: Requests for information about COVID-19, including symptoms, transmission, and treatment.

categories.name: Travel Concerns
categories.definition: Inquiries related to travel restrictions, safety, and protocols during the pandemic.

categories.name: Health and Safety Precautions
categories.definition: Questions about protective measures, such as mask-wearing and sanitization practices.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: Discussions or inquiries about myths, hoaxes, and misinformation regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Vaccination
categories.definition: Questions and discussions related to COVID-19 vaccines, including availability and efficacy.

categories.name: Donations and Support
categories.definition: Requests for information on how to donate or support COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Symptoms and Diagnosis
categories.definition: Inquiries about specific symptoms and how to determine if one has contracted COVID-19.

categories.name: Treatment Options
categories.definition: Questions regarding available treatments and remedies for COVID-19.

categories.name: Community Impact
categories.definition: Discussions about the broader impact of COVID-19 on communities and specific populations.

categories.name: Personal Experiences
categories.definition: Expressions of personal feelings, fears, or experiences related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Surface Transmission
categories.definition: Inquiries about the virus's survival on surfaces and related transmission risks.

categories.name: Animal Transmission
categories.definition: Questions about the potential for animals to carry or transmit COVID-19.

categories.name: Public Health Guidelines
categories.definition: Requests for information on guidelines and recommendations from health authorities.

categories.name: Social Sharing
categories.definition: Requests to share information or resources related to COVID-19 with others.

categories.name: Current Events
categories.definition: Inquiries about the latest news and statistics related to COVID-19.
